record.one_liner: A customer service platform and AI agent suite providing REST APIs, SDKs, and webhook integrations to build public or private messaging and inbox apps.

auth_methods.quote: You can build a private app using your Access Token and it does not require a review.

access_test.quote: To develop a public app you will need to use a development workspace: sign up here to create your free account.

access_ship.quote: These apps have access to other peoples' Intercom data, which means there are specific requirements in order to publish them, such as setting up OAuth and submitting to the Intercom team for review.

api_type.quote: If you aren't able to find an existing app that solves the problem you're facing, you can build your own using our REST APIs and Canvas Kit framework.

api_breadth.quote: Messenger Inbox Contacts Tickets Help Center Reporting Using the APIs Webhooks Fin Agent API
